itinerary.title: Day 1: Marrakech – Welcome to Morocco
itinerary.description:
Arrive in Marrakech, the starting point of your Grand Sahara journey.

Enjoy a private airport welcome and transfer to your hotel. Check in, relax, and take some time to settle into the atmosphere of the Red City.

In the evening, enjoy dinner and a peaceful first night in Marrakech.

Arrival: Personalized airport welcome
Transfer: Private transfer to the hotel
Accommodation: Zalagh Kasbah or similar
Meals: Dinner

itinerary.title: Marrakech – Discover the Red City
itinerary.description:
Spend the day exploring the historic heart of Marrakech, known for its beautiful palaces, gardens, souks, and lively atmosphere.

In the morning, visit the Koutoubia Mosque, Menara Gardens, and Ben Youssef Madrasa.

Enjoy free time for lunch and discover some of the flavors of Moroccan cuisine.

In the afternoon, explore the colorful souks and experience the energy of Jemaa El Fna Square.

Accommodation: Zalagh Kasbah or similar
Meals: Dinner

itinerary.title: Day 3: Marrakech – Ouarzazate – Aït Ben Haddou – Dadès Valley
itinerary.description:
Leave Marrakech and cross the spectacular High Atlas Mountains via the Tizi n’Tichka Pass.

Continue through southern Morocco to Aït Ben Haddou, the famous UNESCO-listed ksar, and explore its traditional earthen buildings and narrow streets.

Then continue to Ouarzazate, known for its kasbahs and film history, before traveling through the beautiful Valley of the Roses towards the Dadès Valley.

Enjoy dinner and a peaceful evening surrounded by the impressive landscapes of the region.

Accommodation: Hôtel Panorama or similar, Dadès Valley
Meals: Dinner

itinerary.title: Dadès Valley – Todra Gorges – Erfoud – Erg Chebbi
itinerary.description:
Continue your journey towards the Sahara Desert and the impressive dunes of Erg Chebbi.

Travel through Tinghir and explore the spectacular Todra Gorges, surrounded by high rocky cliffs.

Continue to Erfoud, known for its fossils and desert landscapes, before reaching Merzouga and the golden dunes of Erg Chebbi.

In the afternoon, enjoy a camel ride across the dunes to reach your desert camp. Watch the sunset over the Sahara before enjoying a traditional Moroccan dinner.

Spend the evening around the campfire and admire the stars over the desert.

Accommodation: Dar Morocco Camp or similar
Meals: Dinner

itinerary.title: Day 5: Merzouga – Midelt – Azrou – Ifrane – Fès
itinerary.description:
Leave the golden sands of Erg Chebbi and travel north towards the green landscapes of the Middle Atlas Mountains.

Cross the beautiful Ziz Valley and stop in Midelt for lunch before continuing through the mountains.

In Azrou, discover the famous cedar forests and look for the local Barbary macaques. Continue to Ifrane, known for its alpine-style architecture and peaceful mountain setting.

Arrive in Fès in the evening, where you can relax after this scenic journey.

Accommodation: Menzeh Zalagh or similar, Fès
Meals: Dinner

Spend the day exploring Fès, Morocco’s historic spiritual and cultural capital.

With a local guide, discover the famous medina, Bou Inania Madrasa, and Nejjarine Square. Walk through the narrow streets and explore the traditional quarters of tanners, weavers, and coppersmiths, where Moroccan craftsmanship is still alive.

Continue to the Mellah, the historic Jewish quarter, and discover another important part of Fès’ rich cultural heritage.

Enjoy a relaxed evening in the city after a full day of discovery.

Accommodation: Menzeh Zalagh or similar, Fès
Meals: Dinner
itinerary.title: Fès – Discover the Soul of Morocco

itinerary.description:
Leave Fès and continue your journey through Morocco’s historic imperial cities towards the Atlantic coast.

Stop in Meknès, the former imperial city of Sultan Moulay Ismaïl, and discover its impressive historic gates and architecture.

Continue to Rabat, the capital of Morocco, where you can visit the Hassan Tower and explore the charming Kasbah of the Udayas overlooking the Atlantic.

In the afternoon, continue to Casablanca, Morocco’s modern economic capital. Enjoy an exterior visit of the impressive Hassan II Mosque, one of the city’s most famous landmarks.

Accommodation: Prince de Paris or similar, Casablanca
Meals: Dinner
itinerary.title: Fès – Meknès – Rabat – Casablanca

itinerary.description:
Enjoy your final breakfast in Casablanca before beginning the journey back to Marrakech.

Travel through the Moroccan countryside and arrive in Marrakech in time for your flight. Your driver will assist you with the transfer to the airport.

Your Grand Morocco journey comes to an end, leaving you with unforgettable memories of the Sahara, mountains, imperial cities, and Moroccan culture.

Meals: Breakfast
Transfer: Casablanca – Marrakech Airport
End of trip: Departure flight from Marrakech

items.region: Sahara Desert, Drâa Valley & Atlas Mountains, Southern Morocco
items.subtitle: From the Golden Dunes of the Sahara to the Majestic Atlas Mountains An Authentic 8-Day Moroccan Adventure
items.title: Morocco Sahara Grand Tour
items.overview:
A Journey from the Sahara to the Atlas Mountains

Discover the beauty of southern Morocco on an 8-day private journey through the Sahara, combining desert landscapes, traditional villages, peaceful oases, and the impressive Atlas Mountains.

This special journey is designed for travelers who want to experience Morocco in a comfortable, authentic, and relaxed way. Travel with our local team and discover the country beyond the usual tourist routes.

Stay in charming riads and local guesthouses, as well as a comfortable desert camp, where you can enjoy the peaceful atmosphere of the Sahara.

Travel through wide desert landscapes, walk among golden dunes, discover palm-filled oases, and meet local people along the way. Enjoy a camel ride at sunset, traditional Moroccan meals, tea around the campfire, and unforgettable nights under the stars.

From the quiet beauty of the Sahara to the dramatic landscapes of the Atlas Mountains, every day offers something different.

A journey of desert, culture, nature, and Moroccan hospitality — created for travelers who want to slow down, discover, and experience Morocco in a truly special way.
included: dinners as mentioned in the itinerary
guided visits in Marrakech and Fès

itinerary.title: Marrakech – Imlil – Marrakech
itinerary.description:
Drive into the Atlas Mountains: Depart Marrakech early and travel toward the heart of the High Atlas Mountains, enjoying panoramic views of dramatic peaks and green valleys.
Imlil Village & Berber Culture: Arrive in Imlil, a traditional Berber village and gateway to Toubkal National Park, home to North Africa’s highest peak. If open, explore the famous Asni Market, held every Saturday.
Optional Hike & Waterfalls: Choose a guided hike around Imlil and Toubkal National Park, visit the nearby waterfalls, or simply relax at a local café while enjoying the mountain scenery.
Lunch & Return to Marrakech: Enjoy a traditional Berber lunch at a local guesthouse before departing Imlil in the late afternoon and returning to Marrakech.

itinerary.title: Marrakech – Tizi N’Tichka – Ait Ben Haddou – Ouarzazate – Kelaa M’Gouna
itinerary.description:
High Atlas Mountains – Tizi N’Tichka Pass: Depart Marrakech early and cross the spectacular High Atlas Mountains via the Tizi N’Tichka Pass at 2,260 meters. Enjoy changing landscapes, from green valleys to rugged mountain peaks and traditional Berber villages scattered along the slopes.
Ait Ben Haddou – UNESCO World Heritage Site: Visit the famous ksar of Ait Ben Haddou, a remarkable fortified village built from earthen architecture. Wander through its ancient alleys and explore the kasbahs that have featured in famous films such as Gladiator and Lawrence of Arabia. Enjoy lunch at a local restaurant nearby.
Ouarzazate – Gateway to the Sahara: Continue to Ouarzazate for a short visit. Explore the city center and experience the atmosphere of this historic crossroads, where the High Atlas Mountains meet the vast landscapes of southern Morocco.
Kelaa M’Gouna – Valley of the Roses: Continue to Kelaa M’Gouna, located in the heart of Morocco’s famous Valley of the Roses. During the spring season, the valley is filled with the fragrance of Damascus roses, traditionally harvested to produce rose water and essential oils. Enjoy dinner and spend the night at a local guesthouse or kasbah hotel.

itinerary.title: Kelaa M’Gouna – Road of 1001 Kasbahs – Todra Gorges – Merzouga
itinerary.description:
Road of 1001 Kasbahs: After breakfast, continue east along the famous Road of 1001 Kasbahs. Travel through dramatic desert landscapes, traditional mud-brick kasbahs, and lush palm oases that have long been part of the caravan routes of southern Morocco.
Todra Gorges: Arrive at the spectacular Todra Gorges, where towering limestone cliffs rise nearly 300 meters above the river. Take a walk through the narrow canyon and enjoy the peaceful atmosphere before stopping for lunch at a local café.
Merzouga & Sunset Camel Trek into Erg Chebbi: Continue to Merzouga and arrive in the afternoon. Meet your camel caravan at the edge of the dunes and ride into the spectacular Erg Chebbi as the sun sets over the Sahara. Reach your private desert camp and enjoy a traditional Berber dinner, mint tea, and an evening of desert music and drumming under the stars. Overnight in a private desert tent.

itinerary.title: Erg Chebbi – Ouarzazate – Marrakech
itinerary.description:
Sunrise over Erg Chebbi: Wake up before dawn and step outside your tent to watch the first rays of sunlight illuminate the Erg Chebbi dunes. Enjoy a peaceful desert sunrise before having breakfast at camp and preparing for the journey back to Marrakech.
Drive Back via Ouarzazate: Leave the Sahara and travel west through the wide desert plains toward the Atlas Mountains. Stop for lunch in Ouarzazate, the famous Gateway to the Sahara, before continuing north through the spectacular southern landscapes.
Return to Marrakech: Cross the High Atlas Mountains once again via the Tizi N’Tichka Pass and continue to Marrakech. Arrival is expected at approximately 8:30 PM, followed by drop-off at your riad or hotel in the city.

items.title: Atlas to Sahara
items.overview:
This 4-day private Atlas Mountains and Sahara Desert tour from Marrakech combines Morocco’s most dramatic mountain and desert landscapes in one unforgettable journey. Start in the High Atlas Mountains with a full day exploring the beautiful Imlil Valley, traditional Berber villages, and surrounding mountain scenery.

Continue south through the spectacular Tizi n’Tichka Pass, the UNESCO-listed Ait Ben Haddou, the Dades Valley, and the impressive Todra Gorges before reaching the Sahara Desert. In Merzouga, enjoy a sunset camel trek across the Erg Chebbi dunes and spend the night at a private desert camp in a traditional tent.

With private transportation and a flexible itinerary, this 4-day journey offers an authentic and comfortable way to experience the Atlas Mountains, southern Morocco, and the Sahara Desert from Marrakech.

accommodation in a local guesthouse or kasbah hotel
overnight in a private desert tent in Erg Chebbi
breakfasts and dinners as mentioned in the itinerary

itinerary.title: Zagora – Sahara Desert Camp
itinerary.description:
Depart Zagora in the afternoon and travel toward the desert, passing through the beautiful landscapes of the Drâa Valley and the surrounding desert plains. Arrive at the dunes in time to enjoy a camel ride across the Sahara as the sun begins to set.

Reach your desert camp and settle into your private tent. Enjoy traditional Moroccan mint tea while watching the changing colors of the dunes. In the evening, have a delicious Moroccan dinner followed by Berber music and drumming around the campfire.

As the camp becomes quiet, enjoy a stargazing experience under the clear Sahara sky, far from city lights. Relax beneath thousands of stars and experience the peaceful atmosphere of the desert.

Dinner and overnight at the desert camp.

itinerary.title: Desert Camp – Zagora
itinerary.description:
Wake up early to watch the beautiful Sahara sunrise over the dunes. After breakfast at the camp, enjoy some free time to walk around the dunes and take photos.

Leave the desert by 4x4 or camel transfer and continue toward Zagora, enjoying the scenery of the desert and Drâa Valley along the way. Arrive in Zagora around midday, marking the end of your 2-day, 1-night Sahara stargazing experience.

notIncluded: anything not mentioned in the included section
items.subtitle: One night, one camp, the whole sky
items.title: Stargazing Night Camp
items.overview: Experience the magic of the Sahara Desert on a 2-day, 1-night stargazing camp from Zagora. Travel through the scenic Drâa Valley to the desert, enjoy a sunset camel ride across the dunes, and spend the night in a private desert camp. After a traditional Moroccan dinner, Berber music, and tea around the campfire, discover the incredible night sky far from city lights. Wake up to a beautiful Sahara sunrise before returning to Zagora, completing a short but unforgettable desert escape.
included: one night in a private desert camp
Berber music and drumming around the campfire
hotel/riad pick-up and drop-off in Zagora

itinerary.title: Fes – Ifrane – Azrou – Midelt – Erfoud – Merzouga
itinerary.description:
Driving Time: Approximately 7 hours 5 minutes

Depart Fes in the morning and begin your journey south toward the Sahara. Travel through Ifrane, known for its alpine-style architecture and beautiful mountain scenery, before continuing to the cedar forests around Azrou, where you may spot Barbary macaques among the trees.

Continue through the Middle Atlas Mountains to Midelt, where you will stop for lunch. In the afternoon, cross the dramatic landscapes of the Ziz Valley, with its rocky gorges, palm-filled oases, and spectacular desert scenery.

Continue through Erfoud toward Merzouga and the golden dunes of Erg Chebbi. In the late afternoon, meet your camel caravan and ride across the dunes while watching the sunset transform the Sahara into shades of gold and rose.

Arrive at your Berber desert camp, where you will enjoy a traditional dinner, mint tea, and Berber music around the campfire. Spend the night in a desert tent beneath the spectacular Sahara night sky.

itinerary.title: Desert Nomad Experience – Merzouga & Erg Chebbi
itinerary.description:
Wake up early to enjoy the peaceful Sahara sunrise over the Erg Chebbi dunes. After breakfast at the camp, begin your return camel ride toward Merzouga, taking in the changing colors and vast desert scenery.

Continue your exploration by 4x4, discovering the hidden landscapes around Erg Chebbi. Visit traditional nomad communities and learn about their way of life in the Sahara. Along the way, discover ancient rock carvings and other traces of the region’s rich history.

Stop for a traditional Berber lunch and experience the unique rhythms of Gnaoua music, an important part of Morocco’s desert culture. Later, return to your accommodation and enjoy a relaxed evening with dinner, local entertainment, and a campfire under the desert sky.

itinerary.title: Merzouga – Rissani – Todra Gorges – Boumalne Dades
itinerary.description:
Driving Time: Approximately 4 hours 45 minutes

After breakfast, leave Merzouga and begin your journey toward the spectacular Todra and Dades valleys. Start with a visit to Rissani, the historic gateway to the Sahara, where you can discover the Mausoleum of Moulay Ali Cherif, founder of the Alaouite dynasty.

Continue through the desert landscapes toward Jorf and Tinjdad, passing beautiful palm groves and traditional oasis villages. Continue to Tinghir, where you can explore the old Jewish quarter and discover more about the region's rich cultural heritage.

Arrive at the impressive Todra Gorges, where towering limestone cliffs rise dramatically above the river. Enjoy lunch in this spectacular setting before taking some time to walk through the gorge and admire the surrounding landscapes.

In the afternoon, continue toward the Dades Valley and Boumalne Dades. Enjoy the scenic mountain roads and dramatic rock formations before settling into a comfortable local hotel. Dinner and overnight in Boumalne Dades.

itinerary.title: Boumalne Dades – Valley of the Roses – Skoura – Ouarzazate – Ait Ben Haddou – Marrakech
itinerary.description:
Driving Time: Approximately 5 hours 35 minutes

After breakfast, leave Boumalne Dades and travel through the beautiful Valley of the Roses, known for its fragrant rose fields and traditional villages. Continue toward Skoura, a lush oasis surrounded by palm groves and historic kasbahs.

Continue to Ouarzazate, the famous Gateway to the Sahara. Stop to visit the renowned film studios and explore the impressive Kasbah of Taourirt, one of the region’s most remarkable historic buildings.

Next, travel to Ait Ben Haddou, a spectacular fortified ksar and UNESCO World Heritage Site. Explore its ancient earthen architecture, narrow alleyways, and panoramic views across the surrounding landscape.

In the afternoon, begin the final journey to Marrakech, crossing the High Atlas Mountains via the scenic Telouet route. Enjoy spectacular mountain scenery before arriving in Marrakech, where your unforgettable 4-day journey from Fes comes to an end.

items.title: Nomad & Berber Immersion

Overview

Embark on an unforgettable 4-day journey from Fes to Marrakech through the spectacular landscapes of southern Morocco. Discover the Middle Atlas Mountains, traditional Berber villages, the dramatic Ziz Valley, and the golden dunes of Erg Chebbi. Enjoy a magical sunset camel ride, spend a night in a Sahara desert camp under the stars, explore the Todra Gorges and the famous Road of 1001 Kasbahs, and finish your adventure in Marrakech.

itinerary.title: Marrakech – High Atlas Mountains – Ait Ben Haddou – Ouarzazate – Dades Valley
itinerary.description:
Depart Marrakech early and begin your private journey through the spectacular High Atlas Mountains. Cross the Tizi N’Tichka Pass at 2,260 meters, enjoying panoramic views of mountain peaks, valleys, and traditional Berber villages.

Continue to Ait Ben Haddou, the famous UNESCO World Heritage Site. Explore the ancient ksar, its earthen buildings, and narrow alleyways before enjoying lunch at a local restaurant.

In the afternoon, continue toward Ouarzazate, known as the Gateway to the Sahara. Depending on your interests and timing, visit Taourirt Kasbah or one of the famous film studios.

Continue through the Valley of Roses toward the Dades Valley, passing palm oases, traditional villages, and dramatic mountain landscapes.

Dinner and overnight in a local hotel or kasbah in Dades Valley.

itinerary.title: Dades Valley – Todra Gorges – Erfoud – Merzouga – Erg Chebbi
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, explore the spectacular Dades Valley before continuing toward the Sahara. Drive through the Road of 1001 Kasbahs and continue to the impressive Todra Gorges, where towering limestone cliffs rise dramatically above the river.

Enjoy a walk through the gorge before continuing toward Tinjdad, Jorf, and Erfoud, passing desert oases and palm groves along the way.

Arrive in Merzouga in the afternoon and meet your camel caravan. Ride across the golden dunes of Erg Chebbi as the sun begins to set.

Arrive at your private desert camp and settle into your tent. Enjoy traditional Moroccan dinner, mint tea, and Berber music around the campfire.

After dinner, take time to experience the peaceful Sahara night and enjoy stargazing far from city lights.

Dinner and overnight in a private desert camp.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Erg Chebbi – Sahara Sunrise – Rissani – Drâa Valley – Marrakech
itinerary.description:
Wake early to experience a spectacular sunrise over the Erg Chebbi dunes. After breakfast at the camp, leave the desert by camel or 4x4 and return to Merzouga.

Continue toward Rissani, the historic gateway to the Sahara. If the market is open, explore the traditional souk and discover local products and desert culture.

Begin the return journey through the dramatic landscapes of southeastern Morocco, passing through the Drâa Valley and its palm-filled oases. Enjoy lunch along the way before continuing toward the High Atlas Mountains.

Cross the Tizi N’Tichka Pass once again and descend toward Marrakech. Arrive in Marrakech in the evening, where your 3-day private bespoke desert adventure comes to an end.
